content: Common internal-tool over-engineering pitfalls for a first version: prioritizing polished UI (custom charts, dashboards, gradients) over a solid data layer; building elaborate state-management/component abstractions before there's proven need; over-specifying workflow (approval chains, multi-stage pipelines) before the smallest useful version is validated. Recommended approach: map the actual current process, identify real failure points, ship the smallest useful version, and add structure only as needed -- consistent with this project's already-adopted 'add Zustand only when needed' convention.
